title: Mario Mushano no Chou Shougi Juku: Mario Mushano's Hyper Shogi School
native_title: マリオ武者野の超将棋塾
overview: Mario Mushano no Chou Shougi Juku is a shogi training game featuring the endorsement and likeness of professional shogi player Katsumi "Mario" Mushano. It includes over 200 shogi problems arranged to teach various techniques, a skill tracker mode that measures various aspects of a player's shogi skills and advises on ways to improve, and a ranking test that allows players to see if they have the skill to obtain shodan ranking, the first official ranking for shogi.
